caseNameFull: L. Anthony, Alert Transfer and Storage Company, Inc., G. T. Hines v. Sam A. Kozer, Secretary of State and I. S. Martine, M. C. Yahne, Fred Gordon v. Sam A. Kozer, Secretary of State
attorneys: Messrs. I. H. Van Winkle, J. M. Devers, and Willis 8. Moore for appellee, in support of the motion., Messrs. Edwin C. Ewing and W. R. Crawford for appellants, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction on the authority of Moore v. Fidelity and Deposit Co., 272 U. S. 317; In re Buder, 271 U. S. 461.
